facts.name: Nicole Menz
facts.assignment: One-half of Indian River County Court Cases; Mental Health Court; Veterans Court; County Election Canvassing Board.

contact.contact_note: Shared county-court office email, not a distinct personal assistant/judge address; Menz phone matched visually to left guide column. Older linked memo names former judges and their numbers, not current Menz contacts.

chambers_communications.summary: Email shared office; subject includes case number/name/matter and profile requests judge name for orders. Copy parties unless authorized ex parte exception. JA cannot give legal advice.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Guide lists uniform motions Thursdays2:30pm. Other motions requested by email. File/serve notice immediately after reservation, include remote credentials and ADA notice. Uniform-motion sentence says notice shall be filed within48hours of the hearing; ambiguity retained without conversion to a before/after deadline. Cancel by immediate JA email and filed/served cancellation notice.

motions_and_conferral.summary: Email requests and party-copy requirement reviewed; no separate general conferral instruction found in this5-page guide. Shared circuit/state requirements are not negated by that omission.

proposed_orders.summary: Word order by email, cover letter certifying agreement or identifying disagreement. Guide deadline10days after hearing unless instructed otherwise. Profile rejects represented-litigant hard copies and asks only order attached; linked historical memo rejects mail and likewise asks only order attached. Preserve cover-letter/attachment wording without deciding reconciliation.

courtesy_copies.summary: Guide hearing-material deadline3business days before hearing; evidentiary courtesy-copy section says2days before proceeding, sent by email. Retain both section-specific deadlines.

remote_appearances.summary: Civil remote appearance requires motion; Zoom phone/video. Obtain meeting ID from JA; no publicly supplied ID inferred.

emergency_routing.summary: E-file detailed emergency motion stating issues, reasons and time per party; email JA. Court determines whether to schedule expedited hearing.

exhibits.summary: Paper exhibits to clerk with sufficient copies for court/clerk/parties; label plaintiff/petitioner numerically and defendant/respondent alphabetically.

case_management_and_trial_setting.summary: CMCs mandatory for counsel/self-represented unless excused; represented parties not required. Request status conference with reasons; court approval then scheduling. Guide instructs filing notice for trial; court assigns dates after pretrial/CMC. Existing shared AO2021-05 linked, to be reconciled in county shared review without duplicating collection.

accessibility.summary: Guide names Kate Bradford, General Counsel, bradfordk@circuit19.org and7728074370 for ADA accommodations; source-specific statement preserved for shared-access review.

noncivil_specialties.summary: Mental-health/veterans programs, criminal merits and election detail outside commercial civil focus; assignment/official guide retained.

facts.summary: Practical county-civil guide reviewed: email scheduling, Word proposed orders, hearing/courtesy materials, motion-based remote appearances and basic CMC/trial/access procedures. Ambiguous notice wording and different source submission requirements preserved.

conflicts.subject: Notice wording
statements: Guide p2 uniform-motion sentence: Notice of hearing shall be filed within 48 hours of the hearing
Same page general notices: filed and served immediately after reserving hearing time
conflicts.disposition: Exact wording preserved; do not infer whether within48hours means before/after.

conflicts.subject: Hearing materials versus courtesy deadline
statements: Guide p2 all hearing materials3business days before hearing
Guide p3 courtesy copies2days before evidentiary proceeding
conflicts.disposition: Retain section-specific periods without controlling-rule determination.

conflicts.subject: Order cover letter and attachment instruction
statements: Guide p3 requires cover letter stating agreement/disagreement
Profile and older linked memo say only proposed order attached
conflicts.disposition: Preserve both; no inference that cover letter must be separate attachment or that either source controls.

conflicts.subject: Historical linked memo identity
statements: Linked memo names David C. Morgan/Joe Wild and older phones
Current profile/guide identifies Nicole Menz/Carlene Wiley
conflicts.disposition: Older memo retained as historical linked source; no old contact substituted into current record.

gaps: No separate personal judge or assistant email established; shared route is published.
Remote meeting ID obtained from JA rather than published in reviewed guide.
